name: tcon-remotion-shorts
description: TCon vertical YouTube Shorts video renderer

scripts.render:episode-01: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts TConShorts out/episode-01.mp4
scripts.render:episode-01:assets: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts TConShorts out/episode-01.mp4 --props='{"useGeneratedAssets":true,"useNarration":true,"useSubtitles":true}'
scripts.still: mkdir -p out && remotion still src/index.ts TConShorts out/preview.png --frame=120
scripts.render:three:prototype: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts TConThreePrototype out/three-prototype.mp4 --gl=swangle
